info.title: Payments API
info.description: Accept crypto payments, pay out to wallets and banks, and settle in the currency you choose. Powered by Basqet.

tags.name: Payment links
tags.description: Create and manage hosted checkout links.

tags.name: Conversions and rates
tags.description: Preview a rate, or move balances between your wallets.

tags.name: Testing
tags.description: Simulate outcomes and replay webhooks in test mode.

secretKey.description: Bearer token. Most endpoints take your secret key (`sec_live_...`). Initialize Transaction takes your **public** key (`pub_live_...`), and Verify Transaction accepts either.

get.description: Returns every supported currency grouped as `FIAT` or `CRYPTO`, with the networks each crypto is available on. Fetch this rather than hard-coding currency IDs.

type.message: type must be one of [FIAT, CRYPTO]

message.example: type must be one of [FIAT, CRYPTO]

post.description: Creates the record of what the customer owes. Returns a reference with status `INITIATED` — no address exists and no rate is locked yet. Takes your **public** key.
Assigns a payment currency, locks the rate, and returns the wallet address, exact crypto amount and a QR code. Moves the transaction to `PENDING`, which starts the 60-minute expiry window.

currency_id.description: Tether : 3, Bitcoin : 4, Quidax Token: 5, Ethereum: 6, Litecoin: 7.

get.description: Returns the current status of a transaction. Use it when a webhook is delayed or to reconcile — it supplements webhooks rather than replacing them.

post.description: Test mode only. Moves a transaction to `successful`, `overpaid`, `underpaid` or `abandoned` and fires the matching webhook. The exact shape of this endpoint is being confirmed — see the Testing guide.

get.description: Replays the webhook for a transaction. Useful when your endpoint was down.

post.description: Creates a hosted checkout link. Static links carry a fixed amount, dynamic links let the customer enter one. Links are reusable and each use creates a new transaction.

title.description: Display name for the payment link.

link_type.description: static requires a fixed amount. dynamic lets the customer enter the amount at checkout.

currency.description: The fiat currency the payment is priced in. Must be uppercase. Call t

amount.description: Required when link_type is "static". Omit or set to null for dynamic links.

metadata.description: Custom data you want to attach to the link. Returned as-is in responses.

pass_fee_to_customer.description: When true, the Basqet processing fee is passed to the customer.

pass_settlement_fee_to_customer.description: When true, the settlement fee is passed to the customer.

code-samples.code:
curl --request POST \
  --url https://api.basqet.com/v1/payment-links \
  --header 'Authorization: Bearer sec_live_xxxxxxxxxxxxx' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{
    "title": "Invoice #1024",
    "link_type": "static",
    "currency": "USD",
    "amount": "150.00",
    "description": "Payment for design services",
    "metadata": {
      "order_id": "order_1024",
      "customer_tier": "premium"
    }
}'

get.description: Returns a paginated list of payment links for your merchant account. By default, only active (non-deleted) links are returned. Use the `status` parameter to retrieve archived links.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Filter links created on or after this date.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Filter links created on or before this date.

parameters.name: search_term
parameters.description: Search links by title or currency code.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by link status. `archived` returns deleted links.

get.description: Retrieve the details of a single payment link by its ID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique ID of the payment link (bq_pl_…).

patch.description: Updates one or more fields on an existing payment link. At least one field must be provided.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique ID of the payment link to update

title.description: Updated display name for the payment link.

link_type.description: Changing to `"static"` requires an `amount`. Changing to `"dynamic"` clears any existing amount.

currency.description: Updated fiat currency for the link.

amount.description: Required when changing `link_type` to `"static"`. Set to `null` with `"dynamic"`.

metadata.description: Replaces the existing metadata. Set to `null` to clear.

pass_fee_to_customer.description: Update whether the Basqet processing fee is passed to the customer.

pass_settlement_fee_to_customer.description: Update whether the settlement fee is passed to the customer.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a payment link. Deleted links are no longer accessible to customers and are excluded from your default list view. This action cannot be undone via the API.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique ID of the payment link to delete.

post.description: Quotes a wallet-to-wallet conversion. Quotes last roughly 10 seconds and can only be used once.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional. Reusing the same key within the quote window replays the same response for your account and environment.

from_currency.description: Currency slug of the wallet to debit.

to_currency.description: Currency slug of the wallet to credit. Must be different from `from_currency`.

amount.description: Amount to convert from your source wallet

post.description: Returns a live rate and equivalent amount for a currency pair. A preview only — it does not move funds.

base_currency.description: Currency slug for the amount you are converting from.

quote_currency.description: Currency slug for the amount you are converting to.

amount.description: Amount denominated in `base_currency`. Strings are accepted when they contain a valid positive number.

post.description: Executes a conversion using a quote from Create Quote. Quotes expire in roughly 10 seconds and can only be used once. Send an Idempotency-Key so a timed-out request is safe to retry.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Recommended. Reusing a key returns the cached result for your account and environment.

reference.description: Your own reference. Must be unique for your account.

get.description: Returns your conversion history for reconciliation.

parameters.name: reference
parameters.description: Filter conversions by your own reference.
